notes.title: Massive Localisation Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, good news! I've finally updated the game with a massive localisation update. This will mean the following languages are now supported: 
- Chinese Traditional
- Chinest Simplified
- French
- German
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Portuguese
- Spanish

Also a variety of fixes have been made over the last 6 months that should improve the game overall. 

Please let me know if you experience any issues and thanks for hanging in there!

notes.title: Major Performance Update!!!
notes.notes:
Forest Farm has had a major performance update. 

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Crafting Update - Craft your own houses and decorate them!
notes.notes:
This month I've been working on adding a large variety of items for players to craft.

This includes houses, giant mushrooms, fences, raised beds and more.

I hope you all enjoy the update. 

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Inventory Bag/Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
The Inventory system has finally been added. This allows players to store all produce, seeds and anything foraged from the forest. 

This allows for much quicker and efficient planting of gardens and makes it much more enjoyable.

All tutorial signs have also been removed and replaced with a friendly NPC who will guide you through the basics of the game.

I feel this is a significant improvement on the overall look of the game and I hope you all enjoy.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Trading Post Update - Trade fruit and vegetables for gold coins
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

I've added the Trading Post, which will allow players to trade the produce they've grown for gold coins!

Gold coins will be used to purchase upgrades to the farm such as the barn, more animals, chicken coop and more.

More traders to come; magic scarecrow, lumber yard (for buying buildings) and the animal dealer.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Clarity Update - Tutorials Added
notes.notes:
Major Clarity Update!

Tutorials have now been added to the Forest Farm Demo which will assist players to understand how to play and what they can get up to in the forest.

Main Tutorials:
Gardening
Fishing
Wood Felling
Fence Moving

Please give the game a try in the upcoming Steam Game Festival!

Happy Gardening!
